rules.priority: bucket: 'Today' = score ≥65 AND within the day's capacity (12 outreach slots), else 'This week'; tie-break = fewer hours to nearest window. Score = time(0-40: ≤24h=40, ≤72h=30, ≤7d=20, ≤30d=10; a high safety signal counts as ≤24h) + acuity(0-35: tier High15/Mod10/Rising10/Low5, ADT≤7d +10, urgent live event (threshold reading, overdose) +10, +5 per high / +3 per medium safety signal cap 10) + data_risk(0-25: 5 per conflict cap 15, +10 if any high signal else +5 if any signal)
rules.confidence: +40 pharmacy≤7d (+20 older) · +20 ADT≤24h (+10 older) · +15 clinical doc received · +15 contact verified≤30d · +10 HRA≤6mo · −20 per non-identity conflict, −10 per identity conflict (penalty capped at 40); <50 = 'resolve conflicts before acting'
rules.reachability: per number: +10 active-record cell / +5 other active-record field / +2 termed-record field · +40 reached≤90d (+20 older; +10 only if member could not confirm meds) · +30 member called from it · +20 in ADT PID · +25 case-worker/address source · −50 not in service · −3 per no-answer; window from HRA best_time, else hour of last success; prepaid → first 10 days of month; channel = text-first if opted in
rules.human_in_loop: Every conflict resolution, next-best-action and AI-drafted note field is 'AI draft' until the clinician clicks Confirm; confirmations are logged with user, time and the evidence shown
